LESSON: NETBALL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.2: Netball

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Netball. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are the skills of passing and catching important in a Netball game?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball
2. perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball
3. appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NETBALL
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Netball helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: NETBALL
Study Netball like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball

What this means
In this part you learn to perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Netball in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Netball is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Netball” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Netball in your own words. (skill: perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Netball to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball.
3. Practise this skill: perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate Netball as a team game for enjoyment.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Netball from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Netball: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Netball?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are the skills of passing and catching important in a Netball game?
2. Why is it necessary to improvise a netball?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Netball means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball.
5. Be able to: perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
